user_text_generator.role: wording and a second same-model review; executable ground truth authored first

audio_judge.required_evidence: actual input and output WAVs plus sandbox trace

dialogue_router.rules: normal next_node_id; explicit question + predefined branch selects first matching stored branch; tool terminal question may consume one fixed FALLBACK within five user turns
dialogue_router.limitations: fixed follow-up dialogue; cannot cover arbitrary user behavior; questions without recognized markers may follow normal route

timing_policy: offline throughput only; precomputed ASR and batch TTS are reported separately; interaction time is not comparable end-to-end latency
reporting: Independent pilot100 and benchmark1000; task pass separate from six dimension quality; no best-answer selection.

revision_source_audit.scope: v0.3 source-data audit and constraint extraction; original authoring provenance retained
